# Gilbert Wat's Blog
> I build AI for purposeful businesses, while raising my family.

Gilbert Wat builds AI for intentional organizations and writes at Cha Chaan Teng about building AI with humanity — informed by a career shipping software across three continents, and by raising a son in Hong Kong.

## Recent Posts
- [如何有倫理地實踐AI](https://www.chachaanteng.co/how-to-practice-ai-ethically/): Reflections on Pope Leo XIV's encyclical on AI ethics, the value of human-centric AI tools, and preserving human essence and dignity.
- [UFO、信仰與天主的肖像](https://www.chachaanteng.co/ufos-and-faith/): Reflections on how the existence of aliens might (or might not) impact Catholic faith and the understanding of being made in God's image.
- [LLMSpeak](https://www.chachaanteng.co/llmspeak/): A reflection on the impact of Large Language Models on writing, the emergence of "LLMSpeak," and how to maintain authenticity in a world of AI-generated content.
- [Taste, Judgment, and Speed as Shields Against AI](https://www.chachaanteng.co/weve-been-told-that-taste-judgment-and-speed-are-the-ultimate-shields-against-ai/): Taste, Judgment, and Speed are often cited as shields against AI. But the future belongs to those with the courage to take risks and the humility to serve a purpose larger than their own.
- [When AI Agents Oversell and Damage Your Brand](https://www.chachaanteng.co/when-ai-agents-oversell-and-damage-your-brand/): A 3-agent architecture (SalesMaker, BrandDefender, Responder) can resolve the issue of AI agents overly focused on sales goals damaging brand integrity.
- [Fun Friday: automating my publishing chore with n8n and Gemini](https://www.chachaanteng.co/fun-friday-automating-my-publishing-chore-with-n8n-and-gemini/): In this Fun Friday, I share how I built an agent using Google Doc, n8n, and Gemini to automate my multi-platform publishing chore.
- [Flies](https://www.chachaanteng.co/flies/): Beyond doomscrolling: I nuked social media and found peace. But not without a supernatural challenges from the get go.
- [Attention is All You Have](https://www.chachaanteng.co/attention-is-all-you-have/): Discover the profound influence of attention on shaping our experience and the potential for transforming challenges through conscious focus.
- [Helping people](https://www.chachaanteng.co/helping-people/): A small encounter that test my intent to help.
- [Chasing bubble](https://www.chachaanteng.co/chasing-bubble/): Life's true joys often lie not in achievements, but in shared, simple moments of pure happiness with loved ones.
- [Where should I go?](https://www.chachaanteng.co/where-should-i-go/): A spontaneous hike reveals life's hidden paths. Sometimes, the clearest way forward appears when we open our eyes and trust the journey.
- [One painting; Two meanings](https://www.chachaanteng.co/one-painting-two-meanings/): Reflections on Hans Holbein's "The Dead Christ in the Tomb" and personal loss.
- [How My Motto Almost Broke Me](https://www.chachaanteng.co/how-my-belief-almost-break-me/): A vulnerable reflection on how the pursuit of continuous 1% daily self-improvement became a source of fear and stagnation, and how fatherhood helped rebuild a healthier foundation.
- [Build a legacy of wisdom for social good with GenAI](https://www.chachaanteng.co/build-a-legacy-for-social-good-with-genai/): A 3-part case study on stewarding a spiritual master's legacy through a GenAI-powered digital sanctuary — built with 20% technology and 80% empathy.
- [You are generating your own suffering](https://www.chachaanteng.co/you-are-generating-your-own-suffering/): How generative AI's "hallucinations" mirror the ways our minds generate suffering through unexamined thoughts and narratives.
- [How developers can 10x their impact with AI in 2025](https://www.chachaanteng.co/how-developer-10x-in-2025/): A career guide for developers at every stage on how to harness Generative AI — from cultivating fundamentals to strategic leadership.
- [The day I was humbled by a SEN student](https://www.chachaanteng.co/humbled-by-sen-student/): A brief encounter with a student with special educational needs that cut through a busy workday with unexpected grace.
- [生成式苦難](https://www.chachaanteng.co/生成式苦難/): [Cantonese] How our memories and emotions can subtly rewrite events like an AI hallucination — and how that insight can set us free.
- [St Theresa of Avila Feast Day](https://www.chachaanteng.co/st-theresa-of-avila-feast-day/): Reflections on St Theresa's autobiography, founding a new Carmelite order against all odds, and what it means to pray with perseverance.
- [Choosing kindergarten for my son](https://www.chachaanteng.co/choosing-kindergarten-for-my-son/): A father's framework for choosing a kindergarten — from aligning values and development goals to practical factors like teachers and community.
